fact: On 5 May 2026 Commune Butihinda trained its staff on Interbank's IBB M+ platform for digital collection of communal revenue, which keeps transaction data and notifies the commune's designated officer, with effective use to begin in budget year 2026-2027 and the classic system retained where there is no internet; the trainer cited Rumonge and Bujumbura Mairie as communes using it since 2023.
title: BUTIHINDA: En marche vers la digitalisation des recettes communales grâce à la plateforme IBB M+
